title: Light radius
wikitext:
'''Light radius''' is a [[stat]] which affects the maximum radius you can see clearly in low [[Light Level]] areas. Your light radius is further reduced by your current percentage of maximum [[life]]. This makes it very difficult to see in dark areas when on [[Low Life]]. An [[Energy Shield Mastery]] and [[Incandescent Heart]] changes your light radius to be based off your proportion of [[Energy Shield]] instead of life, aiding visibility for low life builds. ==Sources that affect light radius== ===Debuffs=== * {{stl|Blind}} overrides your visual light radius to its minimum, though it does not affect the numerical value. ===Monsters=== * [[Gruthkul's Despair]] cast by [[Gruthkul, Mother of Despair]] ** * [[Erebix, Light's Bane]] is the map variant of Gruthkul, Mother of Despair, it also cast Gruthkul's Despair. ===Maps=== * {{il|Whakawairua Tuahu}} has special interactions with light radius. * {{il|Valdo's Puzzle Box}} maps may have this modifier: *: {{ml|MapSupporterDamageRadius|display=stat_text}} ==Unique items== ===Increased light radius=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables = item_stats |join = items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where = item_stats.id LIKE "%light_radius%" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=Light Radius |stat_column1_format=%s%% |stat_column1_stat_format=add |stat_column1_stat1_id=light_radius_+% }} * {{c|foulborn|Foulborn}} {{il|Hinekora's Sight}}: {{c|foulborn|(30-50)% increased Light Radius}} ===Other=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables = item_stats |join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName |where = item_stats.id LIKE "%light_radius%" AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%light_radius_+%%" |large=1 |stat=1 |level=1 }} * {{c|foulborn|Foulborn}} {{il|Incandescent Heart}}: {{c|foulborn|Increases and Reductions to Light Radius also apply to Accuracy}} ==Modifiers== |generation_type=1 |q_orderBy=mods.domain ASC, mods.generation_type ASC, mods.id ASC, mods.required_level ASC }} ===Synthesis mods=== {{#cargo_query: |tables=synthesis_mods, synthesis_mods__mod_ids, mods |join on=synthesis_mods._ID = synthesis_mods__mod_ids._rowID, synthesis_mods__mod_ids._value=mods.id |fields=required_level=Level
required,CONCAT("[[", mods._pageName, "|", mods.stat_text_raw, "]]")=Affix description, item_class_ids=Item classes |where= id LIKE "%LightRadius%" }} ===Scourge mods=== Note that [[Scourge]] mods are considered as legacy mod, as the mechanic is not added to the core game: {{Modifier table |q_tables= mod_stats |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID |q_where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%light_radius%" AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%blight_radius%" AND mods.domain = 1 AND mods.generation_type = 24 |stat_text = 1 |spawn_weights=1 |generation_type=1 |q_orderBy=mods.required_level ASC }} ==Passive skills== ===Base passives=== The following [[passive skill]]s are related to light radius: {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id like "%light_radius%" }} ===Masteries=== The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to light radius: {{Query masteries}} ===Keystone passive skills=== The following [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to light radius: {{Passive skill table |q_where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%light%radius%" AND passive_skills.is_keystone = 1 |large=1 |stat=1 }} ===Ascendancy skills=== The following [[Ascendancy class]] skills are related to light radius: {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where= passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%light radius%" }} [[Category:Game mechanics]] {{sister|poe2wiki}}
